{{Top|title=''Mu''-class shuttle}}
The '''''Mu''-class shuttle''' was a class of [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] manufactured by [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]] designed for long range applications. The ''Mu''-class came in three distinct variants; [[Mu-class shuttle (Model 1)|Model 1]] had limited crew space and seating for 24 passengers, making it ideal for short-range missions. [[Mu-2 long range shuttle|Model 2]] was best suited for long-range scouting missions, with enclosed cabins, a galley, and reduced passenger space.<ref name="GG8">''[[Galaxy Guide 8: Scouts]]''</ref> A [[Mu-3 Shuttle|third model]] was designed for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to transport [[Platoon/Legends|platoon]]-sized units, including special missions and [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] forces.<ref name="RoE">''[[Rules of Engagement: The Rebel SpecForce Handbook]]''</ref>
